_law: Validation Gate Law — every rendered clip must pass deterministic acceptance criteria before editorial assembly. These questions are derivable from upstream artifacts. If a clip fails, find the upstream artifact that failed to constrain the condition. Do not patch prompts with adjectives.

rationale.S1: Validates crystallographic render quality before any credits are spent on dependent clips. If S1 fails, halt. Do not generate further.
rationale.S4: Validates the hardest architectural assumption — ignition as state change, not flame. S4 is the load-bearing visual argument of the entire reel.
rationale.S5: Validates the Möbius palindrome. Must visually echo S1 without narration explaining the connection. Determines whether the visual loop works.
rationale.S2_S3: Comparatively safe — intermediate physical states, less likely to fail catastrophically. Generate last.

render_sequence.gate_rule: S1 must pass before S4 is generated. S4 must pass before S5 is generated. S2 and S3 may be generated in parallel after S1 passes.

fidelity_categories._note: Promoted from LE-002. Every render review question belongs to one of these categories. Categorizing failures by fidelity type enables faster upstream artifact diagnosis — an Energy Fidelity failure traces to energy_arc or camera_language; a Relationship Fidelity failure traces to shot_list visual_direction; an Identity Fidelity failure traces to visual_system palette or what_the_director_must_not_do.
fidelity_categories.entity_fidelity: Does each element in the frame correspond to a specific concept_dna entity — match head crystal, friction surface, contact zone — and nothing else? Failure: elements present that cannot be traced to concept_dna.
fidelity_categories.relationship_fidelity: Does the composition depict the relationship between entities rather than a portrait of one entity? Failure: one entity dominates and the other reads as background. (This is the hero object ban.)
fidelity_categories.energy_fidelity: Does the frame communicate the energy state defined in energy_arc for this shot? Can a viewer infer stored/accumulating/threshold/release/residual from the visual alone? Failure: energy state is ambiguous or wrong.
fidelity_categories.identity_fidelity: Does the frame still feel unmistakably NDCH — restrained, severe, engineered, precise? Failure: drifts toward fantasy, decoration, science demo, or generic AI aesthetic.
fidelity_categories.model_compliance: Did the Runway model produce what the Director specified, or did model priors override the instruction? Failure modes: model defaults to fire aesthetics, soft organic forms, ambient glow, arbitrary motion, or misinterprets crystallographic as decorative.

symbol_emergence_check_schema._law: Physical Primacy Law (Law 16). Operationalizes the question: what does the viewer perceive first — physics or symbol? Promoted from LE-008. This is not a blacklist. It is a stable question applied to every render. The answer determines whether the upstream specification produced sufficient physical reality.
symbol_emergence_check_schema._note: Required for every clip before decision is marked PASS. Fill at review time.

fields.primary_read: What the viewer perceives first: 'physical' or 'symbolic'. If 'symbolic', the clip fails regardless of aesthetic quality.
fields.secondary_read: What the viewer perceives on second examination: 'philosophical', 'emotional', 'none', or 'physical' (if primary was symbolic).
fields.symbolic_read_before_physical: boolean — true if any element receives symbolic interpretation before physical interpretation. true = identity_fidelity FAIL.
fields.result: PASS | FAIL | PASS with residual (symbolic read present but physical read arrives first and dominates)

symbol_emergence_check_schema.diagnostic_on_fail: If symbolic_read_before_physical: true — revise the upstream specification to produce stronger physical reality. Do not add negative constraints to the prompt. The failure is not in the prompt. The failure is in the degree to which the upstream description grounded the visual in observable physical reality.

Does the palette arc progress correctly: cold (S1) → flickering (S2) → first-crimson (S3) → full-palette (S4) → cold (S5)?
Could a viewer without narration perceive the arc: mechanism at rest → incomplete attempts → held contact → threshold crossing → new waiting surface?

MUTED TEST: Could someone understand the doctrine with the audio completely muted? If yes, the Director succeeded. If no, the visuals are illustrating the narration rather than serving as independent evidence. This is the definitive validation question for the completed reel.

Does the reel feel like one continuous transfer of energy (stored → accumulating → threshold → release → residual), or does it feel like five separate visual ideas that happen to share a color palette?

SYMBOL EMERGENCE CHECK: Could a viewer assign symbolic meaning (religious, decorative, cultural) to any element in any clip before assigning physical meaning? If yes, the render fails identity_fidelity regardless of visual quality. This check applies to every clip individually and to the reel as a whole. A growing blacklist of forbidden symbols is not a substitute for this question — this question is the invariant. Promoted from LE-008.

mythic_weight_definition.note: Mythic weight is not an adjective. It is a property that emerges from specific design conditions. These are the constraints that produce weight. If weight is absent, one of these constraints has failed.

properties.description: The subject implies a system larger than itself. The match head implies hands, a person, a room, a life — none of which are shown. The omission carries the weight.
properties.failure_mode: If the clip shows only abstract texture with no implied scale, mythic weight collapses into decoration.

properties.description: The events depicted cannot be undone. Crystal wear accumulates and stays. Ignition propagates and does not retreat. Nothing softens.
properties.failure_mode: If transformation looks fluid, reversible, or gentle, the weight is lost.

properties.description: No visual noise. No particle effects, ambient debris, or atmospheric haze not motivated by the physics. The void is load-bearing.
properties.failure_mode: Cluttered frame = no weight. Every element not traceable to concept_dna is noise.

properties.description: The forms look like they could only be this way. Crystal structure is not chosen aesthetically — it is the structure the physics requires. Propagation follows a structural law.
properties.failure_mode: Arbitrary or decorative shapes remove inevitability.

properties.description: Nothing in frame that does not serve the mechanism. No decorative elements not in the palette, no elements not traceable to an upstream artifact.
properties.failure_mode: Any element that cannot be traced to concept_dna is distraction.

properties.description: Events take the time physics requires. No speed-up for drama. No slow-down for beauty. The pacing is not a stylistic choice — it is the physics.
properties.failure_mode: Arbitrarily slow motion reads as aestheticizing. The weight comes from the physics taking its own time.

mythic_weight_definition.if_mythic_weight_absent: Do not add adjectives to Runway prompts. Find the upstream artifact that failed to constrain the condition that produces weight. Revise that artifact. Recompile. Mythic weight that comes from adding 'severe,' 'mythic,' or 'premium' to a prompt is not mythic weight — it is decoration pretending to be architecture.
